purpose: Surface charge, coating, and targeting evidence per Profile-B preset. A modification is offered ONLY if supported for the actual celastrol formulation, else it is a separate real preset or omitted.

configs.confound: stearylamine also IS the matrix change

surface_charge.interpretation_rule: cationic delivered most celastrol into skin, but the lipid matrix ALSO differs between configs -> present as 'experimentally observed association between surface configuration and permeation', NOT 'isolated causal charge effect'

coatings_and_targeting.status: candidate - separate preset, NOT a toggle on P1

P1_modification_status: No active targeting or stimulus-responsive modification. Surface charge is the only experimentally-varied surface property. Do NOT imply targeted delivery for P1 (uptake/accumulation observed != active targeting).
rule: A coating must not be offered merely because it is common in nanomedicine. PEG/chitosan/HA are only supported in the identified (unopened) systems P3/P4 - they become distinct presets after full-text verification, never free toggles.
